title: AIMING ZOOMS TOWARD THE CROSSHAIR
why:
His 10-29 request: ADS should zoom toward the scope instead of onto the pillager. The camera now follows a world focal point and preserves the aimed ground point through zoom.

aiming zooms toward the crosshair; watch that it never feels seasick and your pillager never leaves the screen
